about: Round 1583. The second host for every NBA Connections fact: basketball-reference.com, one page per man (the Totals table, the birthplace line and its country link, the Draft line, the Hall of Fame line), read by scripts/usConnections/verifyNbaFacts.mjs. seasons are NBA regular season rows by team code (a traded season's total row skipped), aba the ABA rows kept apart, career the NBA regular season totals summed over the team rows. The checker (scripts/lib/usConnectionsCheck.mjs, makeNbaChecker) reads this beside the record and returns unknown wherever the two hosts disagree on a verdict. Never edited by hand; a man it holds is never rewritten.
